meet Vietnam's agarwood and herbs.

An O2O healing journey connecting downtown Ho Chi Minh and the great nature of the Mekong River.

MasterProfileSection.titleMain:
The Master of Artisan Herbal Tea,

Venerable Sunyeop
MasterProfileSection.altBookCover: Venerable Sunyeop’s Healing Herbal Tea Book and Profile
MasterProfileSection.quoteText:
Purifying toxins and elevating natural immunity!

The wildflowers and wild grasses abundant in nature become precious healing teas.
MasterProfileSection.awardTitle:
World-Class Premium Tea

Acknowledged by 200 Michelin Chefs
MasterProfileSection.awardDesc: At the International Taste Institute (ITI) in Brussels, Belgium—the heart of gastronomy—the Master’s self-developed <bold>‘Agarwood Gongjindan Tea’ received the prestigious 2 Stars</bold> through blind tasting by world-renowned Michelin-starred chefs and sommeliers, proving the global competitiveness of K-Wellness tea.
MasterProfileSection.timeline1Title: Asceticism, Illness, and Natural Healing via Herbal Tea
MasterProfileSection.timeline1Desc: Recovered from severe illnesses, including angina, by drinking teas crafted from wild medicinal herbs. Volunteering at a veterans’ hospice for five years, amidst the suffering of life and death, the Master established an <bold>authentic brand philosophy centered on ‘Natural Healing and Meditation’</bold>.
MasterProfileSection.timeline2List1: • Award Winner at the Hainan World Pu'er Tea Competition, China (Proving global excellence)
MasterProfileSection.timeline2List2: • Guest Speaker at CCTV’s ‘Good Food Beijing Forum’, China
MasterProfileSection.timeline2List3: • Hosted ‘Healthy Detox Tea Templestays’ via special invitation in NY/NJ, USA
MasterProfileSection.timeline3Desc: Published <bold>《Venerable Sunyeop’s Healing Herbal Tea》</bold>, a comprehensive collection of 82 herbal tea recipes. Fully launched <bold>‘Maum Jeongwon (Mind Garden)’</bold>, the testbed for our wellness platform along the Bukhan River in Namyangju.
MasterProfileSection.timeline4Desc: Secured public recognition through multiple broadcasts (BBS, EBS, BTN) and documentaries. Successfully established <bold>diversified revenue models for Vietnamese expansion</bold>, encompassing a YouTube channel, B2C commerce, and B2B education.

InfinityHealingSection.hub1Desc: Ensuring daily accessibility for VIP clientele. Establishing initial touchpoints and generating leads through constitution consultations, day spas, and herbal tea purchases.
InfinityHealingSection.hub1Feature3: Herbal Tea / MD Product Exhibition & Sales
InfinityHealingSection.hub2Desc: High-ticket, extended-stay (1-7 nights) intensive detox and forest tea meditation programs tailored for validated VIP clients from the urban centers.
InfinityHealingSection.heading: The Infinity Healing Loop
InfinityHealingSection.description:
A perfect wellness ecosystem where daily emptying in the city intersects

with profound filling in great nature.
InfinityHealingSection.footnote: The urban center acts as a <highlight>‘Brand Showroom & Daily Care’</highlight> facility, while the nature center serves as a <highlight>‘High-Yield Premium Retreat’</highlight>, seamlessly circulating our esteemed clients.

WellnessProgramSection.title: Hyper-Personalized Wellness Programs
WellnessProgramSection.desc:
Beyond mere relaxation, we provide fundamental healing solutions

tailored to each client’s constitution and lifestyle.
WellnessProgramSection.step1Desc: Based on Venerable Sunyeop’s Oriental medicine approach, we precisely diagnose your current physical and mental state, as well as your unique constitution.
WellnessProgramSection.step2Desc: Drawing upon the diagnosis, we design and execute a K-Zen natural healing program exclusively for you.
WellnessProgramSection.step3Desc: We review your transformative progress post-program and prescribe a personalized lifestyle and herbal tea regimen for continuous healing in daily life.
WellnessProgramSection.part2Desc: Two distinct program formats operate in organic harmony, tailored to your schedule and healing objectives.
WellnessProgramSection.prog1Item1Desc: Immediate stress relief and daily care in the city
WellnessProgramSection.prog1Item3Desc: Agarwood aroma spa, natural skin therapy, tearoom meditation
WellnessProgramSection.prog2Item1Desc: Fundamental constitution improvement by clearing body toxins
WellnessProgramSection.prog2Item3Desc: Deep detox diet, grand nature meditation, herb foraging experience
WellnessProgramSection.conclusion:
“The seamless integration of Daily Care at our urban center and Deep Detox at the farmstay

completes an unbroken, flawless K-Zen Wellness Lifestyle.”

PartnershipSection.title1: Strategic Partnership Mapping for Vietnam Expansion
PartnershipSection.desc1: Consolidating the Top 10 potential partner groups into 3 core categories to drive customized proposals.
PartnershipSection.cat1Groups: Vingroup · Sun Group · BRG · BIM · Nova
PartnershipSection.cat1Desc: Conglomerates holding Vietnam’s premium infrastructure. Beyond simple Western spas, they possess a strong thirst for traditional Asian healing contents.
PartnershipSection.cat1Model: Shop-in-shop establishment of the ‘VIP K-Zen Wellness Center’ within 5-star urban hotels and mega resorts.
PartnershipSection.cat2Desc: Conglomerates holding eco-resorts based in grand nature (forests, oceans) and tourism infrastructure linked with aviation (Vietjet).
PartnershipSection.cat2Model: Joint development of nature-based farmstay retreats and launch of detox tour packages linked with flight tickets.
PartnershipSection.cat3Desc: The No. 1 coffee group advocating the ‘Zen’ philosophy and healthcare groups with large-scale herbal and medical infrastructure.
PartnershipSection.cat3Model: Joint R&D of functional herbal teas utilizing Vietnamese agarwood and herbs, with B2B distribution across nationwide VIP lounges.
PartnershipSection.desc2: Minimizing risk and scaling up through the combination of Software (Venerable Sunyeop’s IP) and Hardware (Vietnamese Capital).
PartnershipSection.ins1Desc: Securing negotiation dominance by emphasizing cultural superiority and scarcity, positioning it not as a simple partnership, but as “exclusively providing the essence of Korean traditional temple healing to Vietnamese VIPs.”
PartnershipSection.ins2Desc: Eliminating the risks of direct construction and operation. A model that delegates space and capital investment to conglomerates while generating revenue through program planning and royalty-based consignment management.
PartnershipSection.ins3Desc: Inducing R&D investment from local enterprises with the logic of maximizing added value by processing Vietnam’s abundant ‘Agarwood’ using the secret techniques of a Korean Master.
